purpose: Local farm land decoration artwork. These are static decorative props, separate from aquarium collectibles.
processing: Remove tiny detached alpha components, retain 1px alpha fringe, crop, and contain within a transparent 512x512 canvas. Picnic fits a 488x244 area for a 2x1 footprint; other props fit 488x488. Reproduce from repository root with prepare.cjs.
